evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic urgency framing — the matched-clause construction elevates rehearsal to existential necessity, registering high-arousal alarm about unpracticed rollback.
Flat register recording a cadence decision; no affective charge beyond settled administrative satisfaction.
Neutral attribution line; low-arousal, mildly positive settledness of administrative clarity.
